v.text: middleware.ts: chặn route theo /me/permissions (chỉ UX — máy chủ vẫn kiểm quyền)
Application Tier — .NET 8 · ASP.NET Core Web API (modular monolith)
HTTPS pipeline: RateLimiter → JwtBearer (RS256) → SessionValidationMiddleware → Authorization (HasPermission) → Controller · ProblemDetails (MSGxx)

Application services theo module
AUTH · COOP · FARM · CATALOG · CULT · TRACE · SALES · PAY · LABOR · NOTI · RPT · ADMIN
(IZoneScopeGuard, IStatusTransitionService, IAuditTrail, IUnitOfWork)
Domain model (entity, value object, quy tắc)
Repository — EF Core 8 (OmtsDbContext, schema theo module)

Integration adapters (Omts.Integrations)
ISmsSender · IEmailSender · IPushSender · IZaloOaClient · IFileStorage · …
Polly: timeout, retry, circuit breaker
Cross-cutting: Serilog (log có correlation_id) · OpenAPI · Options (ValidateOnStart) · Health checks
Bí mật (khóa ký JWT, khóa HMAC OTP, API key dịch vụ ngoài): secret store của môi trường, không nằm trong mã nguồn

Schema: auth, coop, farm, catalog, cult, trace, sales, pay, labor, noti, sys
READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON · sao lưu hằng ngày (NFR-02, NFR-12)

(mã xác minh, tin báo)
